description:
FILED s473t2 (Opus triage of the 152 causeless blessed sweep rows), on main 0d783d24.
Probes scratch/s473t2/probes/p4-env.pl and p5-magic.pl E-H.
Source: perl-tests/magic.t 820-912 (env_is shells out to `env` and greps the key).

ROWS BEHIND IT: perl-tests/magic.t 184, 185, 186, 188, 189, 192, 195 and 201
= 8 rows (magic.t 187 is the `utf8::is_utf8` readout = ruled non-support;
191/193 are the "Wide character in setenv" warning counts = #221).

(a) THE UTF8 STORE RULES (magic.t 188/189/192/195, still failing today):
    perl downgrades a utf8-flagged but downgradable key or value to bytes before
    setenv, and encodes a wide one (warning as it goes), so the CHILD's
    environment holds the byte string.  PCL passes the characters through: the
    child reads 'eh zero \xC2\xA0' where perl wrote 'eh zero \xA0' (row 188), and
    a wide KEY never appears in the child at all (rows 189/192).

(b) `local $ENV{K}` DELETES THE KEY (probed, p5-magic.pl E):
      $ENV{__T2A} = 'foo';
      { local $ENV{__T2A};
        print "exists=", (exists $ENV{__T2A} ?1:0),
              " child=", (`env` =~ /^__T2A=/m ? "present":"absent"); }
    perl: exists=1 child=present     PCL: exists=0 child=absent
    (perl's own row for this is TODO -- it wants !exists -- but the CHILD-visible
    half is not, and it is what env_is reads.)

(c) ROWS 184/185/186/201 ARE ORDER-DEPENDENT.  They are blessed as failing (the
    blessed got for 184 is the whole `env` output, i.e. the grep matched every
    line) but they PASS in a `--jobs 1` single-file sweep and under tools/runt on
    0d783d24, and the four store shapes they test (undef, a glob, a ref, and the
    value after a `local` block) all agree with perl in isolation (p4-env.pl).
    magic.t clears %ENV wholesale earlier in the same block, so the suspect is
    that clear; whoever takes this task should start by measuring `%ENV = ()`
    against the child environment.  (#1030 already owns the separate fact that
    `$ENV{X} = undef` leaves the perl-side value DEFINED "" in PCL.)
subject: BUG (%ENV): the store path does not downgrade / encode a utf8-flagged key or value the way setenv does, `local $ENV{K}` with no value DELETES the key instead of leaving it defined-but-empty, and three magic.t rows are order-dependent (9 blessed rows)
